entries.question: delivery shipping time
entries.answer: The estimated delivery time is 7–10 days to the configured European countries. Final delivery terms are published on the Shipping & returns page before sales open.

entries.question: countries europe delivery
entries.answer: Delivery is configured for 27 EU countries. Whether a specific product can be delivered to your country is confirmed on the product page before checkout.

entries.question: price pricing vat shipping
entries.answer: Prices on product pages are reference prices in EUR. They apply only once a product is available to order; VAT and delivery costs are confirmed at checkout.

entries.question: lab report certificate coa
entries.answer: Lab reports are published on the product page once they have been verified and approved for that specific product. If a product page shows no report, none has been published yet.

entries.question: account login password my pages
entries.answer: My pages keeps your saved products and finder choices in this browser. Customer accounts with sign-in are not available yet.

entries.question: saved favourites favorite heart shortlist cart
entries.answer: Use the heart on a product card or product page to save it. Saved products are kept separately from the cart and appear under My pages.

entries.question: find filter goal need skin weight recovery sleep focus product guide
entries.answer: Use the guided product finder to choose a broad interest, a more specific information area and optional priorities. The same filters are used by Ask Vera and the visible catalogue.

entries.question: rating ratings review reviews stars
entries.answer: Reviews are checked before they are published. Products without published reviews show “No ratings yet”.
